stories.title: La juez que investiga la invasión de Ceuta cita a Vivas como testigo y pide las alertas emitidas y sus destinatarios

en.title: Judge investigating Ceuta invasion calls Vivas as witness and requests alerts issued and their recipients
en.summary: A National Court judge has summoned the president of Ceuta and a former government official to testify in an investigation regarding the mass irregular entry of immigrants into Ceuta from Morocco on July 30-31. Testimony is scheduled for September 30.

stories.title: La Fiscalía recurre el tercer grado del exdirigente de ETA Henri Parot

en.title: State Prosecutor appeals third-degree sentence granted to former ETA leader Henri Parot
en.summary: The National Court Prosecutor's Office has appealed a third-degree sentence recently granted by the Basque Government to ETA member Henri Parot, a convicted terrorist serving a cumulative 40-year sentence for 39 murders.

stories.title: El cine español elige 'La bola negra', de Los Javis, como su representante en los Oscars

en.title: Spanish cinema selects 'La bola negra' by Los Javis as its representative at the Oscars
en.summary: Spain's Film Academy has chosen the film 'La bola negra', directed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, as the Spanish candidate for best international feature at the 99th Academy Awards.

stories.title: Los insultos desde Marruecos a Abde provocaron el "no" de Mbappé, Vinicius y Konaté a lucir la camiseta de apoyo a Ceuta

en.title: Insults from Morocco to Abde prompted Mbappé, Vinicius and Konaté to refuse to wear Ceuta support shirt
en.summary: Three football players declined to participate in a support initiative for Ceuta after learning about controversy involving player Abde in the hours before a match, seeking to avoid negative reactions from the neighboring country.

stories.title: La juez Tardón cita como testigos a Vivas y al ex jefe de Gabinete dimitido para conocer "la información de que se disponía" y el motivo "del colapso operativo"

en.title: Judge Tardón summons Vivas and former Cabinet chief as witnesses to investigate information available and reasons for operational collapse
en.summary: A National Court judge is calling witnesses and requesting alerts and risk analyses from police and military agencies regarding a major border crossing from Morocco.

stories.title: La Fiscalía se opone a la decisión del Gobierno vasco de ampliar la semilibertad del etarra Henri Parot

en.title: The Public Prosecutor opposes the Basque Government's decision to expand semi-freedom for ETA member Henri Parot
en.summary: Prosecutors argue that granting the prisoner third-degree penitentiary status is premature and does not fully meet legal requirements.

stories.title: La Fiscalía recurre por "prematuro" el tercer grado al ex dirigente etarra Henri Parot

en.title: The Public Prosecutor appeals third-degree status for former ETA leader Henri Parot as premature
en.summary: Prosecutors acknowledge the prisoner's favorable progress but contend that insufficient time has elapsed since the start of his sentence.

stories.title: La jueza Tardón cita como testigo al presidente del Ceuta por la entrada masiva

en.title: Judge Tardón summons the president of Ceuta as witness regarding mass border crossing
en.summary: A National Court judge is calling the city's president and a former government delegation official as witnesses, requesting documentation of alerts issued.

stories.title: La jueza Tardón cita como testigos al presidente Vivas y al exjefe de gabinete del Delegado de Gobierno en Ceuta

en.title: Judge Tardón summons President Vivas and former chief of staff of Government Delegate in Ceuta as witnesses
en.summary: A National Court judge is requesting information about prior warnings, the work of agents in Moroccan territory, and social media activity that promoted a large-scale gathering.

stories.title: El Museo Thyssen de Madrid se amplía con una segunda sede con la colección de arte contemporáneo de la hija del barón

en.title: The Thyssen Museum in Madrid expands with a second location featuring contemporary art from the baron's daughter
en.summary: The museum will establish a second branch in a building provided by the Ministry of Finance, displaying works from the TBA21 foundation created by Francesca Thyssen, with rehabilitation costs budgeted at 70 million euros.

stories.title: La bola negra, de los Javis, competirá por España en los Oscar

en.title: La bola negra, by the Javis, will compete for Spain at the Oscars
en.summary: The film, which won the best directing prize at Cannes, explores three moments of Spanish history through interconnected lives of men linked by memories of Lorca and family heritage.

stories.title: 'La bola negra', de los Javis, es la elegida para representar a España en la carrera de los Oscar

en.title: 'La bola negra', by the Javis, is chosen to represent Spain in the Oscar race
en.summary: The film, inspired by an unfinished work of Lorca, was selected as Spain's official submission for the Academy Awards over two other contenders.

stories.title: Sánchez aprieta a los empresarios: exige una subida general de sueldos ante el alza del IPC

en.title: Sánchez pressures business leaders: demands general wage increases amid rising inflation
en.summary: The government calls on business organizations to show sensitivity to union demands for renewing an employment and collective bargaining agreement, while announcing another increase to the minimum wage.

stories.title: Plan de choque histórico en REE para evitar que la red de luz colapse

en.title: Historic emergency plan for REE to prevent electrical grid collapse
en.summary: The government compels Red Eléctrica to increase investment by 30 percent in response to pressure from hundreds of companies, marking Spain's largest electrical grid expansion to accommodate data centers and other major projects.

stories.title: El Ibex recupera los 19.600 puntos pendiente de la decisión de la Fed

en.title: Ibex recovers 19,600 points pending Fed decision
en.summary: Investors are adopting a cautious stance in markets ahead of the US Federal Reserve's announcement, with AI and oil references contributing to a temporary pause. The Ibex closed flat the previous day during this period of restraint.

stories.title: La iniciativa de los directivos de la IA a favor de la seguridad provoca una fractura interna en OpenAI y Anthropic

en.title: AI leaders' safety initiative causes internal rift at OpenAI and Anthropic
en.summary: Employees at these Silicon Valley companies face the challenge of implementing in practice the messaging about the need to slow artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: Endesa convierte el baloncesto masculino y femenino en una apuesta común

en.title: Endesa makes men's and women's basketball a shared commitment
en.summary: Endesa united men's and women's basketball leagues in a single presentation, reinforcing a sponsorship strategy extending at least until 2027 with over 100 million euros invested since 2011.
